newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices rise, volume little changed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices rise, volume little changed.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange rose marginally to 510 kilos on Tuesday from Monday's 470 kilos on minor physical demand and despite rising prices, dealers said.
Gold rose to $347.00 an ounce from $344.50 on Monday and to 1,303,500 lira per gram from 1,289,400.
Dealers said physical re-emerged due to expected gold jewellery sales during the approaching Islamic holiday. Turkish markets will be closed next Monday and Tuesday because of the Ramadan holiday.
The Turkish lira eased against the dollar to 116,680 from 116,500 at Monday's close. Dealers said this also helped to push up gold prices in lira terms.
Of the day's trade, 310 kilos were in the morning session. Some 51.0 percent was conducted in lira terms.
